highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.154.0 updates the bundled renderer to Skia m154 and modernizes packaged API documentation.
highlights_body: The release also refreshes HarfBuzzSharp binding generation and includes upstream rendering fixes. Review the intentional HarfBuzzSharp enum changes before upgrading.

breaking.title: UnicodeCombiningClass.CCC133 was renamed
breaking.body: HarfBuzz corrected the upstream constant name while retaining its numeric value. Replace references to CCC133 with CCC132.

breaking.title: GlyphFlags.Defined was removed
breaking.body: The aggregate flag mask is no longer exposed. Combine the concrete glyph flags your code requires instead.

bullets.detail: Aligns the bundled renderer with Skia m154 and incorporates upstream buffer-upload, failed-flush cache, and other rendering fixes.
Compiler-generated XML documentation is packaged alongside the managed assemblies, with public API remarks authored directly in C# documentation comments.
The release does not provide RAW or DNG image decoding; use a supported encoded image format when loading those assets.

contributor_summaries.azchohfi: Improved native HarfBuzzSharp build diagnostics while keeping compiler-warning suppression tightly scoped

preview_summaries.v4.154.0-preview.1.26454.9: Preview 1 opened the 4.154 line with the Skia m154 engine update.
preview_summaries.v4.154.0-preview.2.26471.11: Preview 2 added upstream renderer fixes, packaged compiler XML documentation, and regenerated HarfBuzzSharp bindings.
preview_summaries.v4.154.0-rc.1.26479.14: Release Candidate 1 finalized the line and disabled unsupported RAW and DNG decoding.

harfbuzz_summary: HarfBuzzSharp bindings now follow the HarfBuzz revision bundled by Skia, keeping supported APIs synchronized while excluding unsupported callback-heavy families.
